pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel cover, page 1 of 5, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Create a realistic overhead phone photo of one open notebook page on a warm wood desk. Match the supplied reference image's handmade study-note feeling: pale cream ruled paper, slight paper texture and perspective, a narrow strip of natural wood visible, soft natural window light, clear casual blue-black ballpoint handwriting, sparse translucent pale sage-green and pale yellow marker underlines. This is a new composition, not a copy.
Composition: Chinese hook is the largest first-level text in the upper half, exact English A/B is the second-level text below. In the lower third, two small blue-ink line drawings: left shows a phone call with a tiny short-wait clock; right shows a finger paused just above a booking confirmation button. Keep drawings simple, open, and semantic, without dense hatching. Balanced asymmetry, generous breathing room.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“都是‘等一下’
等人，还是先别行动？
hold on / hold off”
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character, apostrophe, comma, question mark, slash, and English word exactly once and fully legibly. No extra labels, captions, page number, logo, watermark, random writing, UI text, or faux brand.
Style/medium: believable photographed handwritten notebook page; blue-black natural handwriting, not typeset poster lettering. The English phrase is complete and clearly readable.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, gentle real paper shadow, calm study desk.
Color palette: warm cream paper, blue-black ink, tiny pale sage and pale yellow emphasis only.
Safety: keep all core text and drawings at least 8% from left/right edges and 10% above bottom edge; do not crowd the bottom. Long text uses natural line breaks and ample spacing, never tiny compressed type.
Avoid: printed typography, digital infographic cards, stickers, tape, cluttered stationery, neon colors, red/green answer coding, giant symbols, dense crosshatching, malformed hands, duplicated objects, garbled characters.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 实图通过：三行文字准确；中文钩子第一层、完整A/B第二层；电话短等与停止预订语义清楚。

pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel, page 2 of 5, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: A realistic overhead phone photo of one pale cream ruled notebook page on a warm wood desk, matching a handmade study-note set. Soft natural window light, clear casual blue-black ballpoint handwriting, only sparse translucent pale sage-green and pale yellow underlines.
Composition: top heading, then two clearly separated but visually connected notebook sections on the same page. Use the same smartphone in both simple line drawings: upper section shows a person on a call briefly checking an address; lower section shows the phone displaying a simple calendar/booking view with the finger paused before booking. Drawings are small, open, and semantic, with no dense shading. Text remains dominant.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“眼前等一下，事情缓一缓
Hold on. I'll check the address.
等一下，我查查地址。
Let's hold off on booking.
先缓一缓，别急着预订。”
Text accuracy: every Chinese character, apostrophe, period, comma, and English word exactly once, fully legible. No additional words or labels anywhere.
Style/medium: photographed handwritten notebook, blue-black natural pen, believable slight perspective and paper texture; no printed poster type.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, calm practical study note.
Safety: 8% left/right and 10% bottom clear; generous line spacing, natural wrapping only, no tiny text. Keep all five text lines complete.
Avoid: UI gibberish, extra text, page number, logo, watermark, stickers, tape, digital cards, neon, answer-color coding, dense hatching, malformed hand.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 实图通过：中英文逐字准确；同一手机串联通话查地址与暂缓预订。

hold on
让对方稍等，通话中常见
hold off on doing
暂缓做某件事
也可以说 hold off doing；

pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel, corrected page 4 self-test, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Realistic overhead phone photo of one pale cream ruled notebook page on a warm wood desk, in a consistent handmade blue-black ballpoint study-note style. Soft natural window light, sparse pale sage/yellow underlines.
Composition: heading at top. Two equal neutral question sections with ample space. Upper simple line drawing: a phone transfer. Lower simple line drawing: a friend has not confirmed a date on a calendar, beside an unbooked train ticket. Both answer choices in each question use identical blue-black ink and equal weight. Absolutely no answer hints.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“换个场景，选更贴切的一项
1. 转接电话，请对方稍等：
A. Please hold on. I'll put you through.
B. Please hold off. I'll put you through.
2. 等朋友确认日期，先不订票：
A. Let's hold on for a moment.
B. Let's hold off on booking.”
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character, number, colon, apostrophe, period, and English word exactly once. Do not omit ‘I'll’ or ‘Let's’. No other text.
Style/medium: believable photographed handwritten notebook page, very legible blue-black handwriting.
Safety: at least 8% side and 10% bottom safe space. Natural wrapping is allowed for the two long English choices; keep them full size and do not squeeze the bottom.
Avoid: checkmarks, crosses, circled choices, color answer cues, added labels, page number, logo, watermark, digital cards, stickers, tape, clutter, neon, garbled text, dense hatching.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 修正后实图通过：已按最新清单换为两组完整自然句；选项同色同权重，无勾叉或答案暗示。旧题面保存在图4_旧题面_中间稿.png。

pages.prompt:

“答案与判断点
1. Please hold on. I'll put you through.
请对方在电话里稍等。
2. Let's hold off on booking.
暂缓预订，等日期确认。
等候：hold on
暂缓行动：hold off”

Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
